title: Landscaping business-contact and owner-candidate review
hypothesis: For independent landscaping businesses, a published business number can begin a business-contact workflow. A Colorado SOS registered agent can strengthen a matched business identity and owner-candidate hypothesis only when the agent is a person at the principal address; it does not establish ownership of the company, ownership of the handset, a mobile line, or permission to contact the person.
ownerSource: Proposed CO SOS identity match: a person registered agent at the entity's principal address; surname-in-entity is a stronger signal, never owner confirmation.
phoneSource: Implemented recipe-A published Maps business number; CO SOS provides no phone field in this route.

workflow.label: Discover published landscaping business
workflow.detail: Use the live recipe-A Maps route as a business-contact candidate only.

workflow.label: Core landscaping fit?
workflow.detail: Require landscaping, landscaper, lawn care, lawn, landscape, or grounds-maintenance evidence; adjacent-only hardscape, irrigation, tree, pest, and snow-removal results do not prove landscaping fit.

workflow.label: Hold non-core result
workflow.detail: Do not reclassify adjacent-only or generic contractor listings as landscaping.

workflow.label: Independent operator segment?
workflow.detail: Recognize lawn-and-landscape franchise/brand matches before an owner hypothesis; a franchise listing may be a local business contact but does not evidence a local owner cell.

workflow.label: Hold franchise or multi-location listing
workflow.detail: Keep the listing out of the owner-candidate branch pending an approved franchise workflow.

workflow.label: Published business number present?
workflow.detail: A Maps number is an advertised business contact, not a direct owner or mobile claim.

workflow.label: Hold without published contact
workflow.detail: Do not infer or append a person phone from SOS identity data.

workflow.label: Optional CO SOS identity corroboration
workflow.detail: For a matched Colorado entity, retain only aggregate-safe identity semantics: person agent and principal-address match. Surname-in-entity strengthens the candidate signal but does not confirm ownership.

workflow.label: Verify business contact
workflow.detail: Apply existing line-type, live, DNC, and delivery-dedupe gates to the published business number. These gates do not verify identity or owner-handset ownership.

workflow.label: Independent owner and handset evidence?
workflow.detail: A registered agent, named business, or published mobile line alone is insufficient. Keep candidate identity and phone evidence separate.

workflow.label: Hold as business contact
workflow.detail: Do not label or deliver an owner-confirmed mobile without independent owner and handset evidence.

workflow.label: Deliver approved owner-confirmed contact
workflow.detail: Only a future workflow that records independent owner evidence and all contact gates may use this classification.

edges.label: identity match or no eligible CO match
line, live, DNC, or dedupe failed

failures.risk: A lawn, tree, irrigation, hardscape, pest, or snow-removal listing enters the landscaping owner cohort through adjacent vocabulary.
failures.mitigation: Require a core landscaping match; hold adjacent-only and generic results before any owner-candidate inference.

failures.risk: A registered agent is described as the owner or their public filing address is used to find a personal phone.
failures.mitigation: Use CO SOS only as matched business identity/candidate evidence; do not use it for personal-phone or address enrichment, and require independent owner and handset evidence.

failures.risk: A franchise, national lawn brand, or multi-location operator is treated as a one-truck owner-operated business.
failures.mitigation: Route brand matches to a held franchise segment before owner-candidate processing.

failures.risk: An advertised office, dispatch, or shared number is labeled a direct owner mobile.
failures.mitigation: Keep it business-level until line-type, live, DNC, dedupe, independent owner, and handset-evidence gates each pass.

sources.label: CO SOS registered-agent adapter
sources.scope: Good-standing person-agent rows at the principal address, including LANDSCAP and LAWN source segments
sources.reference: src/lib/lead-engine-registers.ts CO_SOS_PATTERNS, coSosAgentRow, coSosAgents; tests/lead-engine-registers.test.ts co_sos_agents

iterations.hypothesis: A Colorado landscaping or lawn entity's registered agent could be treated as an owner-contact source.
iterations.test: Free aggregate-only live query of 20 Good Standing CO SOS rows with a person agent and LANDSCAP or LAWN in the entity name on 2026-09-24; no phone fields were requested and no identities, addresses, or contact values were retained.
iterations.observed: 20/20 had a person agent; 20/20 had both address fields; 15/20 had an exact normalized principal/agent-address match, which is the current parser admission condition; 5/20 had the agent surname in the entity name; 4/20 met both signals. The source supplied no phone measurement.
iterations.change: Treat this as identity-only owner-candidate evidence. Preserve the current person-and-address eligibility rule, use surname-in-entity only as a stronger signal, and prohibit automatic owner, handset, or phone claims.

measurement.result: CO SOS 4ykn-tg5h, Good Standing rows with agentorganizationname null and LANDSCAP or LAWN in entityname: person agent 20/20; both principal and agent-principal address fields present 20/20; normalized exact address match 15/20; surname in entity name 5/20; both signals 4/20. Aggregate-only identity-field coverage; no phone fields requested or retained. It does not measure mobile status, reachability, DNC, ownership of a handset, owner confirmation, or delivery.

cost.basis: Free public-source aggregate identity-field observation only
cost.note: No delivered owner contact was measured. The landscaping brain's historical Anas rates use a different denominator and are not a per-clean cost for this workflow.

implementation.summary: Landscaping is recognized and runs the Maps-first recipe-A discovery and relevance path. CO SOS has an implemented LANDSCAP/LAWN agent adapter, but the landscaping brain entry has no register-source mapping, so the adapter is unreachable for landscaping; neither path establishes owner confirmation or handset ownership.

nextMeasurement: With synthetic Colorado landscaping rows, verify that a name-matched person agent at the principal address is retained only as an identity candidate; an organization agent, address mismatch, adjacent-only listing, and franchise listing are held; no agent address is used for personal-contact enrichment; and no owner-confirmed label can be delivered without separately recorded owner and handset evidence. A later authorized outcome pilot must measure published-contact line type, DNC, reachability, reached owner, and delivery with separate denominators.
